title: Equal-dimension purpose-aligned vertical placement discriminator
scientific_question: At fixed four-state dimension and fixed CURRENT_LAYER_FACE closure, does placing state support in the process region required by a declared hydrological purpose improve that purpose response relative to uniform or oppositely aligned placement, and when does residual error identify closure rather than placement?

selection_basis.S4: Declared surface-purpose integration supports 0-20, 0-40 and 0-80 cm.
selection_basis.G4: Exact vertical mirror of the S4 support hierarchy about the 80-cm column midpoint.

GW_LB.bottom_boundary: fresh dynamic prescribed-head sequence with rise/fall/hold phases

reference_qualification.uncertainty_rule: Use three-level monotone space/time convergence with a GCI-style fine-grid uncertainty per metric. Numerical uncertainty is not an application tolerance.

hypotheses.H1: On GW_LB, G4 is componentwise no worse than U4 on the frozen primary groundwater vector, with at least one strict improvement, for each material that remains in the qualified domain.
hypotheses.H2: On SURF_P, S4 is componentwise no worse than U4 on the frozen primary surface/profile vector, with at least one strict improvement, for each material that remains in the qualified domain.
hypotheses.H3: Equal-dimensional purpose-aligned placement has purpose-specific information value: at least one purpose/material shows the aligned partition strictly improving over U4 without a dimension or closure change.
hypotheses.H4: If an aligned Layer-ROM partition is materially weaker than its same-partition coarse-Richards diagnostic while the coarse-Richards route reaches the frozen high-resolution comparator vector, classify a propagation/closure insufficiency for that purpose/partition; do not infer that more states are automatically required.

decision_rules.PLACEMENT_SUPPORTED: Aligned partition is componentwise no worse than U4 on every primary metric and strictly better on at least one, evaluated per purpose and material.
decision_rules.PLACEMENT_MIXED: Neither aligned partition nor U4 is componentwise noninferior.
decision_rules.UNIFORM_NONINFERIOR: U4 is componentwise no worse than aligned placement and strictly better on at least one primary metric.
decision_rules.CLOSURE_DEFICIT_SUPPORTED: Same-partition coarse Richards crosses the frozen R512_T32 comparator vector while same-partition Layer-ROM does not, with qualified Reference and both routes in-domain.
decision_rules.FOUR_STATE_INFORMATION_OR_RESOLUTION_UNR: Aligned Layer-ROM and same-partition coarse Richards both fail the comparator vector, so P1 cannot assign the deficit uniquely to closure.
decision_rules.APPLICATION_STATUS: REFERENCE_OR_APPLICATION_ENVELOPE_NOT_YET_AUTHORITATIVE unless independent purpose authority is later bound.

stop_rules: No candidate response before Reference qualification.
No changes to partitions, histories, metrics, comparator rules or decision rules after first P1 Reference response.
No application tolerance inferred from numerical uncertainty.
No closure tuning or new closure family in P1.
